value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for ages 1 (walking) to 3 with a parent - their site says Term 1 is Sept 14 to Nov 1 and Term 2 is Nov 2 to Dec 20, though I could not pin down the day or time or the price. Registration opened July 22 at 8am online, per their site. I'll keep watching and text you when I have the day and price.
